member.name: T:Cmf.Foundation.BusinessObjects.Checklist

Supports configurable execution modes, links to BOMs and data collections for traceability, and carries conditions that govern when and to what materials or intervals the checklist applies.

Governs which features, rules, and entity associations are valid for the checklist, and cannot be changed once the checklist is referenced by active rules or instances.

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.BusinessObjects.Checklist.Items

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.BusinessObjects.EntityType.ODSRetentionTime
member.summary: Gets or sets the Time To Live (TTL) clauses for the EntityType table. Example JSON: { "State": [ { "OlderThan": 7, "Location": "default", "OnlyForTerminated": true }, { "OlderThan": 112, "Location": "Delete", "OnlyForTerminated": true } ], "History": [ { "OlderThan": 365, "Location": "Delete", "OnlyForTerminated": false } ] } Notes: OlderThan specifies the age threshold (in days) for the rule. A value less than or equal to zero in OlderThan indicates an infinite TTL (no expiration). Location defines where the data should be moved or whether it should be deleted. OnlyForTerminated determines whether the rule applies only to terminated entities.

It is treated as an opaque identifier: the export objects are written to external storage under a location derived from it that the server controls, and the caller learns that location from the operation's output rather than composing it. Exporting again under the same name replaces the objects written by the previous export, so a caller that re-exports the same dataset should reuse the name instead of generating a new one. Required.

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.BusinessOrchestration.ErpManagement.InputObjects.GetIntegrationEntryInput.PrettyPrintMessages
member.summary: Flag to indicate if the backend host should pretty print the messages in the IntegrationEntry object to them human-readable. By default no modification is done to the messages in the IntegrationEntry object in order to preserve backward compatibility. The following fields are pretty printed when this flag is set to true: "IntegrationEntry.IntegrationMessage.Message", "IntegrationEntry.ResultDescription" and "IntegrationEntry.IntegrationMessage.ResultMessage". The pretty print only occurs if those fields are XML or JSON strings. If they aren't XML or JSON then the messages aren't modified.

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.BusinessOrchestration.ErpManagement.InputObjects.GetIntegrationEntryInput.AutomaticDecompressHandlerContext
member.summary: Ensure that the HandlerContext field of the IntegrationMessage associated with the IntegrationEntry is not a compressed (i.e. zip) file. When this flag is set to true, and the field "IntegrationMessage.IntegrationEntry.HandlerContext" is a zipped file then the service will replace the byte array containing the compressed file with the decompressed contents. The contents of the HandlerContext are returned as a UTF8 base64 string.

member.summary: The 1-based line number of this line within its original side of the comparison, or null when the line has no counterpart on that side (e.g. an Imaginary padding line).

member.summary: Indicates how this line differs from the text it is being compared against (see DiffComputationChangeType).

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.DiffComputationTool.DiffComputationLine.SubLines
member.summary: The finer-grained diff segments nested within this line, populated when ChangeType is Modified to detail which parts of the line's text changed; otherwise empty.

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.DiffComputationTool.DiffComputationLines.Lines
member.summary: The ordered set of diff lines, one per line of the compared text, in the order they occur in the source sequence.

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.DiffComputationTool.DiffComputationResult.SourceSideBySideDiffLines
member.summary: Line-by-line breakdown of the source (old) text as rendered in a side-by-side comparison. Populated only when the result was produced from a side-by-side diff; null otherwise.

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.DiffComputationTool.DiffComputationResult.TargetSideBySideDiffLines
member.summary: Line-by-line breakdown of the target (new) text as rendered in a side-by-side comparison. Populated only when the result was produced from a side-by-side diff; null otherwise.

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.DiffComputationTool.DiffComputationResult.InlineDiffLines
member.summary: Line-by-line breakdown of the changes rendered as a single merged (inline) comparison. Populated only when the result was produced from an inline diff; null otherwise.

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.DiffComputationTool.DiffComputationResult.WereSideBySideDifferencesComputed
member.summary: Indicates which comparison layout the result carries: true when SourceSideBySideDiffLines and TargetSideBySideDiffLines hold the computed differences, false when the differences were computed as an inline comparison in InlineDiffLines instead.

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.DiffComputationTool.DiffComputationResult.WasWhitespaceIgnored
member.summary: Indicates whether leading, trailing, and inter-token whitespace was disregarded when the differences underlying this result were computed.

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.DiffComputationTool.DiffComputationResult.WasCaseIgnored
member.summary: Indicates whether letter casing was disregarded when the differences underlying this result were computed.

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.DiffComputationTool.DiffComputationResult.Status
member.summary: Outcome of the diff computation that produced this result, indicating whether it succeeded and, if not, the reason it could not be completed (see DiffComputationResultStatus).

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.DiffComputationTool.DiffComputationResult.StatusMessage
member.summary: Human-readable description of the outcome recorded in Status, typically the error message when the computation did not succeed.

member.name: P:Cmf.Foundation.DiffComputationTool.DiffComputationResult.StatusMessageInner
member.summary: Additional detail supporting StatusMessage, such as the message from an underlying cause, when the computation did not succeed.

member.name: T:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.BusinessPartner
member.summary: Represents an external party — such as a customer, supplier, manufacturer, or contractor — that participates in business processes tracked by the MES. A single partner may hold multiple roles simultaneously, as indicated by the IsCustomer, IsSupplier, IsManufacturer, and IsContractor flags. Contact details are stored directly on the partner and are not versioned separately.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.BusinessPartner.Comment
member.summary: Free-form annotation that callers can use to record arbitrary notes about the partner not captured by the structured fields.

member.summary: Business fax number for the partner's primary contact, used when fax-based communication with the partner is required.

member.summary: Primary office phone number for the partner's contact person, used for voice communication with the partner.

member.summary: Email address for the partner's contact person, used for electronic correspondence and notifications directed at this partner.

member.summary: Mobile phone number for the partner's contact person, providing an alternative channel when the business line is unavailable.

member.summary: Full name of the primary contact person at this business partner, used when addressing correspondence or identifying the individual to reach.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.BusinessPartner.ContactTitle
member.summary: Professional title or role designation of the primary contact person (e.g., "Procurement Manager"), helping callers identify the appropriate individual to engage for a given business matter.

member.summary: Indicates that this partner acts as a contractor, supplying labor or services rather than goods. When true, the partner may be associated with service-type orders and contractor-specific workflows.

member.summary: Indicates that this partner supplies materials or goods to the organization. When true, the partner may be referenced as the source on purchase orders and inbound material receipts.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MaintenanceActivityOrder.TriggerDate

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MaintenanceActivityOrder.UsageBasedCounterEvent

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MaintenanceActivityOrder.UsageBasedDueDate
member.summary: Gets or sets the projected calendar date on which this usage-based order becomes due, representing the date equivalent of the UsageBasedDue counter threshold and marking the start of the normal-due window.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MaintenanceActivityOrder.UsageBasedEarlyDue

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MaintenanceActivityOrder.UsageBasedEarlyDueDate
member.summary: Gets or sets the projected calendar date on which this usage-based order enters the early-due state, representing the date equivalent of the UsageBasedEarlyDue counter threshold.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MaintenanceActivityOrder.UsageBasedLateDue
member.summary: Gets or sets the usage counter value at which this order becomes late, indicating that maintenance was not completed before the normal due threshold was reached.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MaintenanceActivityOrder.UsageBasedLateDueDate
member.summary: Gets or sets the projected calendar date on which this usage-based order enters the late-due state, representing the date equivalent of the UsageBasedLateDue counter threshold.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MaintenanceActivityOrder.UsageBasedExpression

member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum.

member.summary: The arithmetic mean of the measurement data points included in the calculation.

member.summary: The mean computed across all subgroups of the chart's measurement data, regardless of subgroup boundaries.

member.summary: Measures the dispersion of the included measurement data points around their mean, expressing process variability.

member.summary: The standard deviation computed across all subgroups of the chart's measurement data.

member.summary: The middle value of the included measurement data points when sorted, providing a central-tendency estimate that is robust to outliers.

member.summary: The difference between the maximum and minimum measurement values included in the calculation.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.Cp
member.summary: The process capability index (Cp) expressing how well the process spread fits within its specification limits.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.Cpk
member.summary: Process capability index adjusted for centering (Cpk), equal to the lesser of CpUpper and CpLower. A lower value indicates the process mean is shifted toward one specification limit, reducing effective capability.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.ZScore
member.summary: Standardized score expressing a measurement's distance from the process mean in units of standard deviation, used to compare readings across charts with different scales.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.Pp
member.summary: Process performance index (Pp) measuring overall spread relative to specification limits using total (long-term) sample standard deviation. Unlike Cpk, Pp does not correct for within-subgroup variation, so it reflects actual observed performance rather than potential capability.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.Ppk
member.summary: Process performance index adjusted for centering (Ppk), equal to the lesser of PpUpper and PpLower. Reflects long-term observed performance while accounting for how far the process mean deviates from the center of the specification window.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.OOS
member.summary: Count of measurements that fall outside the specification limits (out-of-specification), indicating non-conforming product regardless of whether the process is statistically in control.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.OOC
member.summary: Count of measurements that violate statistical control rules (out-of-control), evaluated against value1 only. A non-zero value signals assignable-cause variation that warrants investigation even when readings remain within specification limits.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.OOCRate
member.summary: Proportion of measurements that violate statistical control rules (out-of-control rate), evaluated against value1 only. Expressed as a decimal fraction; complements OOC by normalizing the count against the total number of data points.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.OTI
member.summary: On-target index (OTI) quantifying how closely the process mean aligns with the nominal target value relative to the specification width. Higher values indicate better centering on the intended target.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.OCI
member.summary: Overall capability index (OCI) expressing combined process performance and centering relative to specification limits in a single metric, complementing the centered-capability view provided by OTI.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.LCLCR

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.UCLCR
member.summary: Upper control limit of the range sub-chart (UCLCR), bounding the expected maximum subgroup range under a state of statistical control.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.LogicalChartStatisticalIndicators.CLCR

member.summary: Identifies which device along the substrate's horizontal axis the first bin code in Values applies to, interpreted according to the SubstrateMap's SubstrateSide, Orientation, OriginLocation, and AxisDirection coordinate attributes.

member.summary: Identifies which device along the substrate's vertical axis the first bin code in Values applies to, interpreted according to the SubstrateMap's SubstrateSide, Orientation, OriginLocation, and AxisDirection coordinate attributes.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinCode.LID
member.summary: The location identifier.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinCode.Number
member.summary: How many contiguous bin codes are packed into Values. When not explicitly set, this is derived from the length of Values together with the containing map's bin type (for example, a hexadecimal encoding divides the string length by two).

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinCodeMap.BinType
member.summary: The encoding used to represent each device's bin code within a MapE142BinCode's Values, determining how many bytes each device occupies and how to decode them. The reserved encodings are: Ascii, a single ASCII character (1 byte per device); Decimal, a 3-digit integer from 000-255 (1 byte per device); HexaDecimal, a 2-digit hexadecimal value from 00-FF (1 byte per device); and Integer2, a 4-digit hexadecimal value from 0000-FFFF (2 bytes per device).

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinCodeMap.NullBin
member.summary: Code to indicate no device or not measured device in BinCode.Values. It should be represented according to BinType.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinCodeMap.MapType
member.summary: A BinCode object may contains bin code information for a single device, a row of devices or the entire map of devices. The choice depends on whether the primary objective is readability, compactness or flexibility.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinCodeMap.BinDefinitions
member.summary: The one or more MapE142BinDefinition objects describing this map's bin codes after any configured bin conversion has been applied.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinCodeMap.BinDefinitionsBeforeConversion
member.summary: The one or more MapE142BinDefinition objects describing this map's bin codes as originally parsed, before any bin conversion is applied; see BinDefinitions for the converted result.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinCodeMap.BinCodes
member.summary: The one or more MapE142BinCode objects providing this map's raw bin code values; depending on MapType, a single entry may cover one device, a row of devices, or the entire map.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinCodeMap.CoordsToBinCode
member.summary: Index of BinDefinitions keyed by their hashed 'x-y' coordinate (see COORDINATES_HASH_FORMAT), enabling lookup of the converted bin definition applicable at a given position.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinCodeMap.CoordsToBinCodeBeforeConversion
member.summary: Index of the bin definitions as reported before any bin conversion was applied, keyed by their hashed 'x-y' coordinate (see COORDINATES_HASH_FORMAT), enabling lookup of the pre-conversion bin definition applicable at a given position.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinCodeMap.CoordsToMapE142BinCode
member.summary: Index of BinCodes keyed by their hashed 'x-y' coordinate (see COORDINATES_HASH_FORMAT), enabling lookup of the raw bin code entry applicable at a given position.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinDefinition.BinCode
member.summary: A bin category, other that the value assigned to BinCodeMap.NullBin, that may be assigned to a device. It should be represented according to BinCodeMap.BinType.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinDefinition.BinCount
member.summary: The number of devices on the substrate with the specified BinCode. If not present then BinCount is undefined.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinDefinition.BinCountCalculated
member.summary: The actual number of devices on the substrate that have this BinCode, always populated regardless of whether BinCount was supplied; equal to zero when no devices are counted for this bin.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinDefinition.BinDescription
member.summary: A description of the specified BinCode (e.g., '100MHz'). If not present then BinDescription is undefined.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinDefinition.BinQuality
member.summary: Describes the quality of the specified BinCode. The following values are reserved: 'Pass' - Indicates a quality that has commercial value 'Fail' - Indicates a quality that does not have commercial value Other values defined by an application. If not present then BinQuality is undefined.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinDefinition.Pick
member.summary: Indicates whether devices with this BinCode should be processed: true selects them for processing, false excludes them, and an unset value is treated as false.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinDefinition.Color
member.summary: An explicit color override for rendering devices with this BinCode on the substrate map, taking precedence over any automatically assigned color; null if no override has been set, in which case ColorToShow supplies the effective rendering color.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinDefinition.ColorToShow
member.summary: The color to use when rendering devices with this BinCode if Color has not been explicitly assigned.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142BinDefinition.IsTransparent
member.summary: Indicates whether devices with this BinCode should be rendered as transparent, rather than filled with a solid color, on the substrate map.

member.summary: Locates the MapE142Layout that this map data applies to, expressed as a full path using '/' as a delimiter from the top level layout to the layout being specified, for example: WaferLayout/L1/DeviceLayout. Resolved against LayoutId to populate Layout.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142SubstrateMap.SubstrateSide
member.summary: The side of the substrate to which this map's coordinate system applies, used together with Orientation, OriginLocation, and AxisDirection to resolve device coordinates. Defaults to TopSide when not present.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142SubstrateMap.Orientation
member.summary: Coordinate system attribute that defines the orientation of the substrate in relation to the map data. This variable increases in the right (clockwise) direction from 0º. It is restricted to values from 0-359º. Default value if this item is not present is 0º.

member.summary: Determines how device coordinates grow away from OriginLocation: UpRight (the default when not present), DownRight, UpLeft, or DownLeft.

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142SubstrateMap.Layout

member.name: P:Cmf.Navigo.BusinessObjects.MapE142XYDimensions.YValue
